notes.type_correctness: All types are explicit and strict — AgentEntry interface is well-defined with union types for model/stage/category. No implicit any anywhere in the feature files.
notes.pattern_adherence: Two issues fixed: AgentsSection.tsx had stale copy ('9 specialized agents' should be '11'), and Navbar.tsx dropped pre-existing useLocation/isDocsPage logic that hid the Docs link on docs pages — restored both. All imports use @/ alias, cn() used for conditional classes, shadcn/ui used throughout.
notes.test_coverage: 6 tests cover the main interaction paths: initial render (11 agents), search by name, search by primaryJob, model filter, clear-filters, and zero state. All critical filter combinations tested. Mobile card rendering is implicitly covered since both table and cards render in jsdom.
notes.security: Static SPA — no server-side code, no secrets, no new dependencies that introduce attack surface. @testing-library/user-event added as devDependency only.
notes.architectural_alignment: New /agents route follows the established page pattern (Navbar + main + FooterSection). Shared data module in src/data/ is a clean separation. Component uses shadcn/ui Table, Select, Badge, Input, Button correctly.
